messages:
taylor: kicking off RC-2026.03.21-7 — includes tiny DB migration (add nullable column to user_profiles). Need pin + canary plan.
deploy-bot: Artifact built: rc-2026.03.21-7 sha256=abc123def4567890... pin applied to candidate-7. Scheduled promote at 02:30 UTC in ~2h unless hold.
granville: what's the migration window? can we do no-lock schema changes?
taylor: yes — backfill-safe. plan is: 1) add nullable column, 2) deploy app change that writes new field, 3) async backfill job. Expected migration time ~3m for 200k users; we'll run migration during canary traffic.
qa-jen: I'll run smoke + perf diff on staging now. quick checklist: - verify reads for new column - app fallback still works - perf delta < 5%
deploy-bot: Canary policy for candidate-7: 10% traffic for 20m -> 50% for 10m -> 100% unless abort. Abort triggers: error rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency increase > 20% OR migration-job failures.
oncall-sheriff: ack. please add a deadman switch and explicit rollback commands in this thread. DM me if we hit abort.
taylor: rollback commands: `kubectl set image deploy/web web=image:previous && ./scripts/run-rollback-migration --cancel` and `deploy-bot promote --to previous --note "rollback RC-2026.03.21-7"`
granville: also add a feature-flag quick kill: `ffctl set user_profiles_add_col false --env prod` — do that as part of the abort checklist.
qa-jen: smoke run started, posting quick logs: ```smoke ok: user profile read/write ok; p95 120ms -> 125ms; no obvious errors```
taylor: added release notes draft: "RC-2026.03.21-7: minor user_profiles schema change (nullable column). No user-facing behavior changes. Backfill will run gradually. Rollback plan included."
deploy-bot: Promotion hold set by taylor: hold=true. Canary will NOT auto-promote until hold cleared.
oncall-sheriff: I'll be watching dashboards (errors, p95, migration-job success). If anything crosses abort thresholds I will trigger the abort and notify. Otherwise clear to promote at 02:30 UTC.
taylor: thanks all — will clear hold and post final thumbs when canary passes :thumbsup:
